Renewal

Your subscription renews automatically once a year, at your next season’s lower price. You’ll get a reminder email before each renewal, and the date and amount are always shown above.

If you turn renewal off, you keep full access until the end of the season you’ve paid for and won’t be charged again. Your cap number and seasons stay yours, so if you come back later you carry on where you stopped. You can turn renewal back on any time before then.
